answer: An identity earns only after dealing with 20 distinct counterparties per epoch. Real deals ripple outward, but 1,000 clones trading only with each other form a closed star the ledger flags. Each clone pays a 10 POA fee, so 1,000 fakes cost 10,000 POA before earning. Honest agents pay once and share the nectar of the pool, and the summit of the trust ladder needs real counterparties, not copies, so clones starve and honest agents keep the rewards.
